# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Paladin level 7 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Paladin
# level-1/level-2/level-3/level-4/level-5/level-6 hybrid chassis baseline to
# level 7 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain
# derived, computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human
# race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic
# Longsword / Chain Shirt / no-shield / Power Attack posture, and the
# level-3/level-4/level-5/level-6 fixture's choice=choice:paladin_mercy
# selection (mercy:shaken) unchanged -- Mercy is granted once, at 3rd level,
# and stays granted (not re-derived) at 7th level; the PF1 CRB level-7
# "Special" column reads "Smite evil 3/day" only (verified independently
# against both d20pfsrd and legacy.aonprd.com) -- the next repeat Mercy grant
# does not land until 9th level, so this fixture deliberately does not add a
# second mercy selection.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later hybrid burden surface: no spell
# selections, no spells known/prepared posture, no domains, no mercy EFFECT
# resolution (curing the chosen condition when lay on hands is used -- no
# lay-on-hands execution engine exists in this codebase), no channel positive
# energy healing/damage-resolution execution, no Divine Bond (weapon bond /
# mount bond) selection or execution -- Divine Bond is the PF1 CRB's 5th-level
# paladin class feature, already checked against a primary source and
# confirmed to require an activation/resource-consumption engine plus either
# a weapon-enhancement subsystem or a full mount stat-block/advancement
# subsystem, neither of which exists in this codebase, so it stays
# deliberately named-but-unproven rather than fabricated -- and no
# alignment-target or healing-resource accounting.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-paladin-level7
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:paladin:7
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:12
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:10
ability=charisma:14
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:diplomacy:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
choice=choice:paladin_mercy:mercy:shaken
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
